startersHint: A starter sets the colour, place and size of the captions. You can change them under More options.
pickHint: Pick a video from your phone or computer, up to {max} MB. It is not uploaded.
tooLong: Only the first {max} minutes are used.
readingSound: Reading the sound of your video...
noSoundFound: The sound of this video could not be read, or it has none. The new video will have no sound.
fileFailed: This video could not be opened. Try an MP4 or MOV file, or open this page in Chrome.
tooBig: This file is bigger than {max} MB. Cut it shorter with your phone's own editor first, then add it here.
wordsHint: Add an SRT or WebVTT file, or paste the text below. No file yet? Tap Use sample captions to see how it looks, or make a file with Tap-to-Time Captions or Speak-to-Captions.
sampleLines: Add your SRT file to replace these
textLabel: Subtitle text (you can fix it here)
skipped: {count} parts could not be read and were skipped.
noCues: No captions were found in that file. It should be an SRT or WebVTT file with lines like 00:00:01,000 --> 00:00:03,000.
subtitleFailed: That file could not be read.
beyond: {count} captions start after the end of the video and will not show.
needCaptions: Add subtitles above to make the video.
positionHint: Phone apps put buttons and your name near the bottom, so the middle or top can be cleaner for Reels.
shift: Move all captions later (seconds, use a minus to move them earlier)
shiftHint: If the words show a little early or late, move them here. 0.5 moves every caption half a second later.
pictureSizeHint: Smaller makes a smaller file. A video is never made bigger than the original.
qualityHint: High keeps the most detail. Medium is smaller and still looks good on a phone.
noMake: This browser cannot make a video file. Try a recent Chrome, Edge or Safari.
slowNote: This browser makes the video by playing it, so it takes as long as the video. Keep this page open. Chrome and Edge are faster.
keepOpenSmooth: Making the video: {done}% done, about {left} seconds left. Keep this screen on and stay on this page.
keepOpen: Keep this screen on and stay on this page while the video is made. It takes as long as the video.
failed: The video could not be made. Try a smaller picture size, or a recent Chrome.
smoothNote: Saved as an MP4 file with every frame drawn.
webmNote: This browser saves WebM video. It plays in Chrome, Edge and Firefox. If an app does not accept it, open this page in Chrome on a computer or a recent Android phone and save again.
notSaved: Your video and subtitles are never uploaded. Only your look choices are remembered on this device.
